headlines.title: 吴清：长钱长投的制度体系不断完善
headlines.summary: 11月14日，证监会主席吴清在参加2026中国资本市场学术年会时表示，2024年以来，社保、保险、年金净买入A股超1.5万亿元，专业机构力量稳步壮大，指数、ETF等产品供给持续丰富，长钱长投的制度体系不断完善；融资端，发行上市、并购重组、再融资等制度包容性适应性持续提升。今年前九个月，股票、债券等直接融资占社会融资增量的比重已近50％。（人民财讯）

headlines.title_en: Wu Qing: The institutional system for long-term money and long-term investment is being continuously improved
headlines.summary_en: On November 14, CSRC Chairman Wu Qing said at the 2026 China Capital Market Academic Annual Meeting that since 2024, social security funds, insurance funds and annuities have net purchased more than RMB 1.5 trillion of A-shares; the strength of professional institutions has grown steadily; the supply of products such as indices and ETFs has continued to enrich; and the institutional system for long-term money and long-term investment has been continuously improved. On the financing side, the inclusiveness and adaptability of systems for issuance and listing, M&A and restructuring, and refinancing have continued to improve. In the first nine months of this year, direct financing through equities, bonds and other channels accounted for nearly 50% of the increase in total social financing. (People's Financial News)

headlines.title: 吴清：科学把握节奏的同时加强对科技企业发行上市的制度适配性研究
headlines.summary: 证监会主席吴清在参加2026中国资本市场学术年会时表示，进一步深化制度包容性适应性研究。资本市场作为市场化资源配置的重要平台，要进一步研究深化投融资综合改革，加快构建适应创新规律、产业规律的直接融资体系，统筹发挥私募市场与公开市场、股票市场与债券市场的协同功能，尤其是要在科学把握节奏的同时，加强对大型和新型科技企业发行上市的制度适配性和风险应对机制研究。同时，要全面准确理解新质生产力发展的科学内涵，深入研究支持新型消费、传统产业升级等不同领域优质企业上市发展，不断改善和优化上市公司结构，促进市场均衡协调发展。

headlines.title_en: Wu Qing: While scientifically grasping the pace, strengthen research on institutional adaptability for the issuance and listing of tech companies
headlines.summary_en: CSRC Chairman Wu Qing said at the 2026 China Capital Market Academic Annual Meeting that research on the inclusiveness and adaptability of systems should be further deepened. As an important platform for market-based resource allocation, the capital market should further study and deepen comprehensive investment and financing reform, accelerate the building of a direct financing system that adapts to innovation and industrial patterns, and coordinate the synergistic functions of the private market and the public market and of the stock market and the bond market. In particular, while scientifically grasping the pace, it is necessary to strengthen research on institutional adaptability and risk-response mechanisms for the issuance and listing of large and new-type technology enterprises. At the same time, it is necessary to fully and accurately understand the scientific connotation of the development of new quality productive forces, conduct in-depth research on supporting the listing and development of high-quality enterprises in different fields such as new consumption and traditional industrial upgrading, continuously improve and optimize the structure of listed companies, and promote balanced and coordinated market development.

headlines.title: 吴清：进一步深化市场稳定长效机制研究
headlines.summary: 证监会主席吴清在参加2026中国资本市场学术年会时表示，中国资本市场从未像今天这样与全球资本市场高度联动、传导共振。面对高度不确定的外部环境和输入性风险，需要我们加强对全球资本市场周期变化、资产定价逻辑演变、风险传导联动等规律性认识，进一步强化跨境跨市场跨行业风险的研究应对，系统构建稳的机制、稳的力量、稳的生态，有效防范市场异常波动。

headlines.title_en: Wu Qing: Further deepen research on long-term mechanisms for market stability
headlines.summary_en: CSRC Chairman Wu Qing said at the 2026 China Capital Market Academic Annual Meeting that China's capital market has never been as highly interconnected with global capital markets, with transmission and resonance, as it is today. Facing a highly uncertain external environment and imported risks, we need to strengthen understanding of the regularities of global capital market cycle changes, the evolution of asset pricing logic, and risk transmission and linkage, further strengthen research and response to cross-border, cross-market and cross-industry risks, systematically build mechanisms, forces and an ecosystem for stability, and effectively prevent abnormal market fluctuations.

headlines.title: 吴清：研究评估量化、减持等制度的优化和公平合理的监管安排
headlines.summary: 证监会主席吴清在参加2026中国资本市场学术年会时表示，进一步深化市场微观结构研究。为进一步提升市场定价和发展质量，需要深入研究改善资本供给结构，加快发展壮大长期资本、耐心资本；深入研究改善预期引导机制，减少“羊群效应”“短期化”交易带来的市场波动；还要深入研究评估量化交易、股份减持等制度规则的优化和公平合理的监管安排，切实保护好投资者合法权益。

headlines.title_en: Wu Qing: Study and assess the optimization of systems such as quantitative trading and share reduction, and fair and reasonable regulatory arrangements
headlines.summary_en: CSRC Chairman Wu Qing said at the 2026 China Capital Market Academic Annual Meeting that research on market microstructure should be further deepened. To further improve market pricing and development quality, it is necessary to conduct in-depth research on improving the capital supply structure and accelerate the development and expansion of long-term capital and patient capital; conduct in-depth research on improving expectation-guidance mechanisms and reduce market volatility caused by the "herd effect" and "short-term" trading; and also conduct in-depth research and evaluation of the optimization of institutional rules such as quantitative trading and share reductions and of fair and reasonable regulatory arrangements, so as to effectively protect the legitimate rights and interests of investors.

headlines.title: 吴清：进一步深化人工智能与资本市场双向赋能研究
headlines.summary: 证监会发布吴清在首届中国资本市场学术年会开幕式上的致辞。其中指出，需要进一步深化人工智能与资本市场双向赋能研究。不可否认，人工智能对科学研究、产业创新和生产生活的系统性、深层次影响正在快速发生，但其长远影响仍需结合技术迭代、场景落地、组织变革和有效治理等持续观察。资本市场既要积极适应新技术变革，在估值定价、信息披露等方面加强制度研究，精准支持相关“硬科技”企业发展壮大并有效增进社会福祉；又要深入研究人工智能对生产力和生产关系重塑在资本市场的传导映射，加快研究责任认定、数据安全、客户保护、系统风险，有效防范算法黑箱、AI网络攻击、提升金融基础设施韧性等重点

headlines.title_en: Wu Qing: Further deepen research on two-way empowerment between artificial intelligence and the capital market
headlines.summary_en: The CSRC released Wu Qing's speech at the opening ceremony of the first China Capital Market Academic Annual Meeting. It noted that research on the two-way empowerment of artificial intelligence and the capital market needs to be further deepened. It cannot be denied that the systemic and deep-level impact of artificial intelligence on scientific research, industrial innovation, and production and life is occurring rapidly, but its long-term impact still needs to be continuously observed in light of technological iteration, scenario implementation, organizational change and effective governance. The capital market should actively adapt to new technological changes, strengthen institutional research in areas such as valuation and pricing and information disclosure, precisely support the development and growth of relevant "hard tech" enterprises and effectively enhance social welfare; it should also conduct in-depth research on the transmission and mapping in the capital market of artificial intelligence's reshaping of productive forces and production relations, accelerate research on responsibility determination, data security, customer protection and systemic risk, and effectively prevent key issues such as algorithm black boxes and AI cyberattacks and enhance the resilience of financial infrastructure.

headlines.title: 吴清：资本市场改革要统筹好稳与进等关系
headlines.summary: 证监会主席吴清在参加2026中国资本市场学术年会时表示，新形势下推进资本市场改革发展稳定，有很多重大理论和实践问题需要抓紧深化研究。A股市场有2亿多股票投资者、8亿多基金持有人，这要求在市场建设中，既要研究借鉴成熟市场发展的一般规律，更要深入研究中国的市场特点和面临的结构性问题，坚持市场化、法治化、国际化改革方向的同时，统筹好稳与进、效率与公平、发展与安全等辩证关系，坚定走好中国特色金融发展之路。

headlines.title_en: Wu Qing: Capital market reform must properly coordinate the relationship between stability and progress
headlines.summary_en: CSRC Chairman Wu Qing said at the 2026 China Capital Market Academic Annual Meeting that under the new situation, advancing the reform, development and stability of the capital market involves many major theoretical and practical issues that need to be urgently and deeply studied. The A-share market has more than 200 million stock investors and more than 800 million fund holders, which requires that in market development we should not only study and learn from the general laws of mature market development, but also conduct in-depth research on China's market characteristics and structural problems it faces. While adhering to the direction of market-oriented, law-based and internationalized reform, we should coordinate dialectical relationships such as stability and progress, efficiency and fairness, and development and security, and firmly follow the path of financial development with Chinese characteristics.

headlines.title_en: CSRC Chairman Wu Qing: Total A-share market value exceeds 100 trillion yuan
headlines.summary_en: [CSRC Chairman Wu Qing: Total A-share market capitalization exceeds RMB 100 trillion] CSRC Chairman Wu Qing said on November 14 at the 2026 China Capital Market Academic Annual Meeting that the development of capital market segments continues to advance in depth, a equity market system featuring differentiated development and complementary functions has basically taken shape, and total A-share market capitalization has exceeded RMB 100 trillion. China's bond market, formed jointly by exchanges and the interbank market, exceeds RMB 210 trillion, with science and innovation bonds, green bonds and REITs precisely meeting national strategic needs. There are more than 170 futures and options products covering commodities and financial categories, basically covering the main industrial sectors of the national economy.

headlines.summary_en: On November 13, China and the United States held the first meeting of the Trade Council under the China-US economic and trade consultation mechanism via video conference. Guided by the important consensus reached at the meeting between the Chinese and US heads of state, the two sides focused on implementing the outcomes of previous China-US economic and trade consultations and conducted candid, in-depth and constructive exchanges on tariffs, the "300 billion versus 300 billion" reciprocal tariff reduction arrangement, agricultural trade and other issues of respective concern.

headlines.title_en: The number, revenue, and market value of new economy companies in A-shares all account for more than half
headlines.summary_en: [Number, revenue and market capitalization of new-economy companies in A-shares all exceed half] CSRC Chairman Wu Qing said at the opening ceremony of the first China Capital Market Academic Annual Meeting that among the more than 5,500 listed companies in the A-share market, new-economy companies account for more than half of the whole market in terms of number, revenue and market capitalization. The CSRC disclosed the relevant information on the 14th. Wu Qing said that China's capital market has always resonated with China's economic reform and grown together with the real economy, continuously growing and expanding through exploration and innovation, and has gradually developed into an important market with global influence that roughly matches the size of China's economy.

headlines.title: 吴清：提升资本市场抵御各类“黑天鹅”等风险事件的能力
headlines.summary: 【吴清：提升资本市场抵御各类“黑天鹅”等风险事件的能力】11月14日，证监会主席吴清在参加2026中国资本市场学术年会时表示，全球资本市场正在经历新一轮的资产再定价、再平衡。这需要积极践行全球治理倡议，深化资本市场监管合作，共同研究应对不确定难预料因素，增强确定性制度供给，不断提升资本市场抵御各类“黑天鹅”“灰犀牛”等重大风险事件的能力和韧性。

headlines.title_en: Wu Qing: Enhance the capital market's ability to withstand various risk events such as "black swans"
headlines.summary_en: [Wu Qing: Enhance the capital market's ability to withstand various risk events such as "black swans"] On November 14, CSRC Chairman Wu Qing said at the 2026 China Capital Market Academic Annual Meeting that global capital markets are undergoing a new round of asset repricing and rebalancing. This requires actively practicing the global governance initiative, deepening capital market regulatory cooperation, jointly studying how to respond to uncertain and unpredictable factors, enhancing the supply of certainty in institutions, and continuously improving the capital market's ability and resilience to withstand major risk events such as "black swans" and "gray rhinos".

headlines.title_en: Wu Qing: The number and market value of companies in the new economy sector account for more than half of the entire market
headlines.summary_en: [Wu Qing: Number and market capitalization of new-economy companies account for more than half of the whole market] On November 14, CSRC Chairman Wu Qing said at the 2026 China Capital Market Academic Annual Meeting that among the more than 5,500 listed companies in the A-share market, new-economy companies account for more than half of the whole market in terms of number, revenue and market capitalization. At the same time, listed companies' awareness and ability to reward investors have effectively improved. Since the promulgation of the new "State Council Nine Measures" more than two years ago, listed companies have distributed nearly RMB 7 trillion in dividends, about three times equity financing in the same period, and share repurchases and cancellations have become a regular choice for some listed companies.

headlines.title: 吴清：进一步深化市场稳定长效机制研究 防范市场异常波动
headlines.summary: 【吴清：进一步深化市场稳定长效机制研究 防范市场异常波动】11月14日，证监会主席吴清在参加2026中国资本市场学术年会时表示，进一步深化市场稳定长效机制研究，中国资本市场从未像今天这样与全球资本市场高度联动、传导共振。面对高度不确定的外部环境和输入性风险，需要我们加强对全球资本市场周期变化、资产定价逻辑演变、风险传导联动等规律性认识，进一步强化跨境跨市场跨行业风险的研究应对，系统构建稳的机制、稳的力量、稳的生态，有效防范市场异常波动。

headlines.title_en: Wu Qing: Further deepen research on long-term market stability mechanisms to prevent abnormal market fluctuations
headlines.summary_en: [Wu Qing: Further deepen research on long-term market stability mechanisms and prevent abnormal market fluctuations] On November 14, CSRC Chairman Wu Qing said at the 2026 China Capital Market Academic Annual Meeting that research on long-term market stability mechanisms should be further deepened. China's capital market has never been as highly interconnected with global capital markets, with transmission and resonance, as it is today. Facing a highly uncertain external environment and imported risks, we need to strengthen understanding of the regularities of global capital market cycle changes, the evolution of asset pricing logic, and risk transmission and linkage, further strengthen research and response to cross-border, cross-market and cross-industry risks, systematically build mechanisms, forces and an ecosystem for stability, and effectively prevent abnormal market fluctuations.

headlines.summary_en: On the afternoon of November 13, 2026, the Department of International Economic Relations invited Martin Wolf, deputy editor and chief economics commentator of the Financial Times, to give an online special lecture on the global macroeconomic situation. Vice Minister of Finance Liao Min attended and presided over the event. (Cailian Press)

headlines.title: 中信证券：看好中国光通信的长期发展趋势 建议重点关注深度受益于全球AI基建的核心龙头标的
headlines.summary: 中信证券指出，光互联产业的技术升级与需求爆发仍在持续演进，光模块向高速率加速迭代，光网络向NPO/CPO/OCS多维拓展。近期市场对海外地缘政策传闻存在担忧，中信证券认为，不宜过度博弈短期的政策情绪，而应回归全球AI算力建设的真实需求。

headlines.title_en: CITIC Securities: Bullish on the long-term development trend of China's optical communications; recommends focusing on core leading stocks that deeply benefit from global AI infrastructure
headlines.summary_en: CITIC Securities noted that technological upgrading and explosive demand in the optical interconnect industry are still evolving, optical modules are accelerating iteration toward higher speeds, and optical networks are expanding in multiple dimensions toward NPO/CPO/OCS. Regarding recent market concerns over overseas geopolitical policy rumors, CITIC Securities believes that investors should not overly speculate on short-term policy sentiment, but should return to the real demand for global AI computing power construction.

headlines.title: 中证协启动券商财务数智化应用调研
headlines.summary: 中国证券业协会日前向各证券公司下发通知，开展财务数智化应用调研，为行业深化财务数智化建设、提升财务核算质效和推动财务职能升级提供参考。此次调研问卷将财务数智化建设划分为五个依次递进阶段，聚焦六大财务领域，同时把AI相关风险列为重点，做到“提效”与“安全”并重。（中证金牛座）

headlines.title_en: Securities Association of China launches research on financial digital-intelligence applications at brokerages
headlines.summary_en: The Securities Association of China recently issued a notice to securities companies to conduct a survey on financial digital and intelligent applications, providing reference for the industry to deepen financial digital and intelligent development, improve the quality and efficiency of financial accounting, and promote the upgrading of financial functions. The survey questionnaire divides financial digital and intelligent development into five progressive stages, focuses on six major financial areas, and also lists AI-related risks as a key priority, emphasizing both "efficiency improvement" and "security". (China Securities Journal Bullseye)
